name: particles condense into the mark, then burst
looks: A ring of small bright particles scatters and drifts inward around a dark field, settling into a small pixel-grid mark at the centre. Concentric rings pulse outward from the mark as it locks, like a shockwave.
build: A 2D canvas of seeded points easing from scattered start positions to sampled pixel-grid targets on power3.out, opacity ramping up as each lands; crossfade to the crisp SVG/DOM mark in the last 0.1s. The ring burst is a couple of stroked circles scaling from 0 opacity-faded out on power2.out, timed to the mark locking.
sound: A rising shimmer as the particles gather, resolving into a soft hit as the mark completes and the rings pulse out.
prompt: Condense a field of scattered bright particles into a small geometric mark at the centre of a dark frame, then send a couple of rings pulsing outward from it the instant it locks into place. Use this as the pivot into the brand's identity card.
